brief: Breakout timing: Q3 2024. Single best opportunity: paperclipai/paperclip - Open-source agent management app for developers
Deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness - Modular AI plugin framework for developers
Dream-num/univer - Unified AI agent workspace for productivity tools
